name: Current Lines
description: A fan of fine current lines behind your content, with short pulses of light travelling along some of them.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of current lines. About a third of them carry a pulse.

props.name: colors
props.description: Tail and head colour of each pulse. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the pulse speed. At 1 a pulse takes 6 to 14 seconds to cross.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the lines. Other div props are passed through.
